title: CloudMandap DAAI Fellowship
organizer: CloudMandap Pvt Ltd with IIMS College
summary: A three-month fellowship on AWS cloud architecture, taken alongside the degree. I worked through scalability, IAM, VPC design and cloud security patterns, and spent the time learning how infrastructure decisions are argued and defended rather than just configured. It ended with the Cloud Practitioner exam.
